title: ASSURANCES AS TO LABOR STANDARDS
description: NEH's assurances that professional performers and supporting personnel on a funded project are paid at least the prevailing minimum compensation and work in safe conditions. The applicant names its institution; Grants.gov fills in the signature and date.
notes: The paper form names the institution in the middle of its first sentence. The form quotes the sentence's two halves exactly, as the descriptions of the first two sections, with the institution's name between them.
The burden statement, which Grants.gov shows behind a button, is quoted as the last section. The NEH letterhead and the ESA-38 footer are left out.
Signature and Submitted Date are filled in by the API on submission (`gg_post_population` rules `signature` and `current_date`), so the form shows them read-only.
Labels are the DAT's, in title case. Standardizing them on the question bank's labels comes later.
